directories.src/js: Unminified JavaScript extracted from the Blogger template
directories.src/css: Unminified CSS extracted from the Blogger template
directories.src/config: Runtime configuration and Blogger page-data adapters
directories.dist/js: Production JavaScript bundles for CDN publication
directories.dist/css: Production CSS bundles for CDN publication
directories.dist/assets: Versioned static assets used by CDN bundles
